description: Synthetic inventory shaped like a connection-event prototype: a participant token, a centre, a phone lookup for returning participants, a connection log and an optional reflection. It holds field descriptions only, never participant values. It reflects the open risk that no consent, retention, access or correction record exists yet.

rd49-3y-then-summary.description: RD-49 option B: keep 3 years from last activity, then reduce to summary; a deletion request overrides.

event-day-only.description: Deleted at the end of the event day.

stores.description: One row per participant token issued at the event.

fields.name: participant_token
fields.purpose: link a participant's connections within one event without storing a name
fields.deletion_path: deletion request removes the token row and cascades to the connection log

fields.name: entry_code_hash
fields.purpose: let a participant re-open their own card on a second device
fields.deletion_path: dropped with the event-day cleanup job

stores.description: Which local centre a participant came from.

fields.name: home_centre
fields.purpose: group connections by centre for follow-up
fields.deletion_path: deletion request clears the centre value on the token row

stores.description: Lets a returning participant find their earlier token by phone number.

fields.name: phone_number
fields.purpose: find a returning participant's earlier token
fields.deletion_path: deletion request removes the lookup row

stores.description: One row per confirmed connection between two tokens.

fields.name: from_token
fields.purpose: record who connected with whom, by token

fields.name: to_token
fields.purpose: record who connected with whom, by token

fields.name: matching_pool
fields.description: Participants are matched only within separate pools keyed by a participant-group attribute (a segregated participant flow).
fields.purpose: keep matches inside the pool the event design specifies

stores.description: Optional free-text reflection a participant may add after a connection.

fields.name: reflection_text
fields.purpose: let a participant note what a connection meant to them
fields.deletion_path: deletion request removes the reflection row
